defect: Two overlapping profile saves read the same revision and both succeeded; the later whole-config write could discard the first profile edit.
change: Settings profile persistence reserves the SQLite writer transaction, checks the revision loaded by the request, and rejects a stale edit before saving. Existing form feedback reports the conflict.

targeted.scope: Two real Flask processes against a disposable SQLite database; one edit survives, one stale write is rejected. Extended regression also verifies a fresh retry retains both edits and global settings.

deployment.status: installed; bounded native frame check passed
deployment.rollback: Restore config.py, modern_admin_settings_runtime.py and flask/views.py from f121d98b or verified backup; reload Gunicorn only. Do not restore database or media.

limits: This test covers overlapping requests through save_settings_config_revision, not every configuration writer.
Sequential submissions from an old open form are not covered by a form revision token in this change.
Concurrent behavior is exercised on the deployed SQLite backend; other database engines are not certified.
No production settings changed; acquisition remains active.
This is not completion of the full control matrix or the overall acceptance goal.

initial_regression.failed: modern_admin_settings_runtime_test.py: service must not depend on Flask/db.session
initial_regression.resolution: Moved transaction reservation into the injected persistence adapter. Existing guard unchanged and passing; real concurrency/retry test passes after correction.
